bip_draft:
Building Calmly Crashing in public:

Today's reminder came from a story about sitting with someone weekly and writing their life down — not for content. For them.

I've been treating the launch like the only thing that counts. Meanwhile the typewriter logo is chosen, teal / cream / ember is locked, EB Garamond-style type is set, and the plain-page journal is still unfinished on my desk.

What didn't work this week: rushing the catalog shape before the products are real. Shop stays not live until the real things are ready and I say yes.

x_posts.text:

Typewriter logo. Teal / cream / ember. Shop stays dark until the real things are ready.

Small on purpose.

x_posts.title: Bloom climbing — choose the slower option
x_posts.text:
I keep choosing the slower option on purpose.

Handwriting over a draft that finishes itself. Product photography over lifestyle heroes. Waiting for real products before the store goes live.

In a week that wants speed, that still feels like the honest move.
